name: Augmented Hero
body:
Prerequisites: 5th-level Jin-Ku bounty hunter, at least 2 levels in non-bounty hunter classes.

Benefit: You add half your total levels in non-bounty hunter classes to your Jin-Ku bounty hunter level when determining if you gain a new augmentation.

If you are an 11th-level or higher Jin-Ku bounty hunter, you improve your bomb damage by +1d6, to a maximum of +5d6. At 20th level, you gain your choice of either armor mastery or firearm mastery.
